title: Tripulantes
description: Crew Modpack is a simple modpack with a nice visual style, still maintaining a vanilla feel but with a more vibrant look.
body:
A Simple Modpack: Enhanced Visuals, True Vanilla Core
"A simple modpack created by a fan, designed to provide a beautiful and vanilla-like experience."

If you love classic Minecraft gameplay but desire a modern, visually stunning touch, this modpack is for you. A Simple Modpack subtly enhances the game world, focusing on:

Beautiful Visuals: Graphics enhancements (such as lightweight shaders, lighting optimization, and new weather effects) that transform the visual experience without the bloat of heavy mods.

Vanilla Focus: The core gameplay remains faithful to the original Minecraft. No new complex items, blocks, or radical progression changes are introduced.

Performance Optimization: Includes essential performance mods to ensure your journey is smooth and stable, even with the visual upgrades.

It's the perfect way to experience the Minecraft you know and love, but with an updated and polished look. Install, play, and enjoy the beauty of your world!
